snippet.title: SUSHISNK – Trailer | Roguelite Auto-Battler Where Your Sushi Fight on Their Own (Free Demo)
snippet.description:
Steer a line of sushi plates and they attack on their own.
Buy sushi in the shop, merge three of the same sushi to level it up, and stack Sushi Family synergies to build your own platter. A roguelite auto-battler, with sushi.

Wishlist and free demo (Services 1–10) on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5332210/SUSHISNK/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer_v4_en

You are free to stream, record, post and monetize SUSHISNK gameplay. No advance notice needed.

Developer: Kariya Zucchini
X: https://x.com/zucchinitnd6

Note: generative AI was used to help create some assets, including the sushi character art (disclosed on the Steam store page).

#SUSHISNK #indiegame #roguelite
